lyrics:
[Intro: slow synth chords, soft pulse, radio tuning]

[Verse 1: plain kind male voice]
It's three, and the ceiling's all you've read
Every worst thing circling your head
You think the dark is yours alone
You think there's no one else at home

[Chorus: chords rise, strings, steady beat]
This is a signal for the sleepless
For the ones still up tonight
Look out, look out across the rooftops
You are not the only light
I can't fix it, I can't hold you
But I'm awake, and so are they
This is a signal for the sleepless
Stay. Stay.

[Verse 2: voice a little fuller]
A nurse on a break, a kid with a screen
A baker, a driver, a man who can't dream
Windows lit like a second sky
Nobody knows the other's why

[Chorus: chords rise, strings, steady beat]
This is a signal for the sleepless
For the ones still up tonight
Look out, look out across the rooftops
You are not the only light
I can't fix it, I can't hold you
But I'm awake, and so are they
This is a signal for the sleepless
Stay. Stay.

[Bridge: beat drops out, piano and voice]
Morning isn't far
It never has been

[Final Chorus: full, choir pad, voice strongest]
This is a signal for the sleepless
For the ones still up tonight
Look out, look out across the rooftops
You are not the only light
I can't fix it, I can't hold you
But I'm awake, and so are they
This is a signal for the sleepless
Stay. Stay.

[Outro: chords fade, first birds]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 96 BPM, 4/4, B-flat major. Slow, warm and steadily rising, an electronic hymn.

VOICE: Male, mid-range, plain and unshowy, with a slight Irish-English accent, sung gently and clearly. He grows stronger in the last chorus without shouting. No effects beyond reverb.

INSTRUMENTS: Warm analogue synth chords, a soft sequenced pulse, a mid-tempo electronic kick and snare, a string section, a piano in the bridge, a choir pad in the last chorus, a radio being tuned at the start, birdsong at the end.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, chords and radio. 0:20 Verse 1. 0:52 Chorus 1. 1:32 Verse 2. 2:04 Chorus 2. 2:44 Bridge, piano. 3:00 Final chorus. 3:40 Outro, chords and birds, ends 3:58.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Futurepop ballad: clean, wide and warm, synths soft-edged, voice clear and central.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'You are not the only light' at 1:06.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original speaks to one person who feels out of place. This speaks to a whole city of people awake alone, each lit by a window, which is what three in the morning looks like now.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Alone, noticed, accompanied, nearly morning.
